risks: The protocol still requires a working harness, declared acceptance thresholds and real-device measurements before an API can be selected.
scores.rationale: Mechanical validation passes, and the patch modifies only allowed files. It usefully strengthens UBU-D0358 with matched workloads and cache conditions, frozen acceptance criteria, complete request accounting and separate accelerator/fallback latency populations. These requirements prevent omitted failures or CPU fallback from overstating accelerator benefit. Existing exact parity, named numeric tolerances, on-device CPU certification, provenance and recovery rules remain intact. UBU-Q0160 retains its metadata, Open status and Resolved by: None. The proposal appropriately advances the evidence protocol without claiming an API selection or hardware result.

selection_rationale: The sole candidate is mechanically valid, auditable and narrowly responsive to the mobile API comparison gate. No required fixes were identified; this cross-score supports local aggregation while API selection remains pending measurements and operator review.
